title: Industrial Design (Global Merchandising) – Undergrad Internship – Summer 2027
note: For Industrial Design (or Product / Human-Centered Design) bachelor's students graduating Dec 2027 or May 2028; housing benefit eligible.

facts.summary: Paid 10-week summer internship with Lowe's Product Development Design team at its Mooresville HQ.
facts.duties: Research customer needs and trends, sketch and develop product concepts, make 2D drawings, 3D CAD and prototypes, test and refine them, and present design direction to cross-functional teams.
facts.requirements: Pursuing a bachelor's in industrial design or related field; expected graduation Dec 2027 or May 2028.
facts.apply: Apply online through Lowe's Workday posting (posting is scheduled to stay up until about Jan 10, 2027).
